recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical arrangement of five male figures emerging from monolithic, cylindrical gold pillars. The figures wear metallic, crinkled gold jackets and are positioned within arched alcoves. The lower half of the composition features a surreal vertical stretching effect that blends the figures' torsos into the pillars, set against a sterile, architectural background with soft, diffused lighting.
coreVisualRelationships: Repetition of five vertical monolithic forms across the horizontal plane
Integration of human subjects into architectural elements via vertical motion blur
High-contrast relationship between metallic gold textures and muted sage-green backgrounds
Symmetrical balance centered on the middle figure
coreInvariants: Vertical stretching/smearing effect on the lower half of the subjects
Metallic, reflective texture on clothing and pillars

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects evenly spaced across the mid-ground, scaled to occupy the full height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure and the large, stylized title text positioned at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top title down to the central figure, then radiate outward to the flanking figures, following the vertical lines of the pillars.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the composition is densely packed with vertical architectural elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted Sage Green (Background walls and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Brown/Black (Subject hair and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in metallic highlights; low saturation in the architectural environment to emphasize the gold sheen.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The first letter features an elongated, curved tail that underlines subsequent letters
Characters are merged to look like a single poured-metal object

composition.overlap: Overlays the top of the pillars

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a complex, liquid 3D display face and a minimal, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif.

preserve: Wide tracking for the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the molten aesthetic of the primary title
Approximates the structured, wide-tracked bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate five men in gold metallic jackets standing in arched alcoves. Apply a vertical smear effect to their lower bodies so they blend into gold cylindrical pillars. Use a sage green and gold color palette with soft studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large 3D molten gold title at the top center with sharp serifs and liquid extensions. Add a wide-spaced, small uppercase sans-serif subtitle at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the vertical smear effect present on the pillars?
Are there exactly five alcoves and figures?
Is the top text rendered with 3D gold depth?
Is the bottom text extremely wide-tracked?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the vertical smear effect
Color of the metallic finish (e.g., silver instead of gold)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects

mustAchieve: Consistent metallic sheen across all gold elements
Seamless blending between figures and pillars

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold texture looks reflective and not matte.
Check that the vertical stretching doesn't look like a glitch but a deliberate design choice.
Verify the 3D text has a clear light source consistent with the scene.
Confirm the background colors remain muted to let the gold pop.
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical repetition + vertical motion blur integration + metallic gold palette + 3D liquid typography.
